Across our real-world evaluations, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is one of the most accurate transcription models available today and twice as accurate as Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0, at the same price.</p><p>Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 is built on the audio foundation model behind Grok Voice. Grok Voice already powers tens of thousands of customer-support calls a day, transcribes millions of hours of video narration, and runs voice agents in physical products, including the Grok assistant in Tesla vehicles. It is trained on a unique dataset of live, noisy, multilingual audio recorded across a diverse set of environments and refined with post-training.</p><p>The result is one of the most accurate transcription models for speech in real-world settings.</p><h2 id="accuracy"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#accuracy">Accuracy</a></h2><p>Most transcription models do well on clean, single-speaker audio. Real-world audio is harder: flaky phone lines, competing voices, local accents, and phone numbers or email addresses read aloud. We built Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 for the hardest audio across conditions and environments.</p><p>On the public Artificial Analysis leaderboard, Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 ranks first for accuracy among 32 streaming models.</p><div class="not-prose my-12 lg:-mx-12"><div class="bg-card relative flex min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="bg-card flex items-center Analysis</a></span></div></div></div><h3 id="internal-evaluations"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#internal-evaluations">Internal Evaluations</a></h3><p>In addition to public benchmarks, we measure word error rate on four internal sets drawn from production traffic: telephony audio from customer-support calls, conversations with Grok, spoken credentials such as account codes and email addresses, and short multilingual voice commands. Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 improves on Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0 across all four, and on telephony it leads every model we tested.</p><div class="not-prose my-12 lg:-mx-12"><div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2"><div class="bg-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="px-5 py-4"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Telephony (8 kHz)</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">Customer support calls · English</p></div><div class="px-3 pb-2 pt-1 sm:px-4"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:300px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="bg-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="px-5 py-4"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Conversational</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">Conversations with Grok · English</p></div><div class="px-3 pb-2 pt-1 sm:px-4"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:300px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="bg-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="px-5 py-4"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Credentials</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">Phone numbers, emails, addresses · English</p></div><div class="px-3 pb-2 pt-1 sm:px-4"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:300px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="bg-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="px-5 py-4"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Short Phrases</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">Voice-assistant utterances · 19 languages</p></div><div class="px-3 pb-2 pt-1 sm:px-4"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:300px;min-width:0"></div></div></div></div></div><h2 id="multilingual"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#multilingual">Multilingual</a></h2><p>Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 transcribes dozens of languages, detects the language automatically, and follows mid-recording switches in a single pass. Multilingual accuracy is its largest improvement over Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0.</p><div class="not-prose my-12 lg:-mx-12"><div class="bg-card relative flex min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="bg-card flex items-start justify-between px-6 py-4"><div class="w-full leading-6"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Transcription accuracy</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">Word Error Rate (%). Lower is better.</p></div></div><div class="overflow-x-auto"><div class="min-w-[1400px]"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:420px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="px-6 py-4"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2"><div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2"><div class="size-3" style="background-color:#FF6309"></div><span class="text-primary text-sm font-medium">Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0</span></div><div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2"><div class="size-3" style="background-color:#24282D"></div><span class="text-primary text-sm font-medium">Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0</span></div><div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2"><div class="size-3" style="background-color:#A9B1BB"></div><span class="text-primary text-sm font-medium">ElevenLabs Scribe v2</span></div><div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2"><div class="size-3" style="background-color:#D6DAE3"></div><span class="text-primary text-sm font-medium">Deepgram Nova-3</span></div></div></div></div></div><p>Short phrases such as in-car commands give the model little context to identify the language. On our short-phrase set, word error rate drops from 20.6% to 6.8%.</p><h2 id="features"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#features">Features</a></h2><p>Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 supports advanced configuration and controls. Existing Speech-to-Text API integrations get the accuracy improvement with no code changes:</p><ul>
<li><strong>Batch and streaming.</strong> Transcribe recorded files and URLs, or transcribe an audio stream in real time.</li>
<li><strong>Word-level timestamps.</strong> Each word has precise start/end times and confidence scores.</li>
<li><strong>Speaker diarization.</strong> Label each speaker in the transcript, at no additional cost.</li>
<li><strong>Multichannel transcription.</strong> Transcribe up to 8 channels independently.</li>
<li><strong>Key term biasing.</strong> Pass up to 100 domain terms per request, such as product names or medical vocabulary.</li>
<li><strong>Text formatting.</strong> Numbers, dates, currencies, phone numbers, and email addresses are returned in written form.</li>
<li><strong>Filler word removal.</strong> Omit fillers such as &quot;um&quot; and &quot;uh&quot; from the transcript.</li>
<li><strong>Smart turn detection.</strong> Detect the end of a speaker&#x27;s turn for voice agents.</li>
</ul><div aria-hidden="true" class="not-prose relative left-1/2 my-16 h-[160px] w-screen -translate-x-1/2 sm:h-[220px] lg:my-20"><canvas class="block size-full"></canvas></div><h2 id="grok-voice-powers-atlassian-loom"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#grok-voice-powers-atlassian-loom">Grok Voice Powers Atlassian Loom</a></h2><p><a href="https://www.loom.com/">Atlassian Loom</a> is widely used for recording and sharing screen recordings. Atlassian found Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 more accurate than their existing solution for transcribing Loom videos. Accurate transcripts open up new AI workflows: record an action plan in Loom, pipe the transcript into Cursor, and it makes the code updates directly.</p><figure class="not-prose border-border my-12 border-l pl-6 sm:my-16 sm:pl-8"><blockquote class="font-display text-primary/85 text-xl leading-snug tracking-tight sm:text-2xl">“<!-- -->We&#x27;ve always believed the best way to move work forward is to capture context once and let it flow everywhere. With Grok powering Loom&#x27;s speech-to-text and Cursor turning that into code, we&#x27;re closing the loop from context to code: record what you mean, and the work gets done. It&#x27;s a glimpse of where AI-assisted development is headed.<!-- -->”</blockquote><figcaption class="text-primary/40 mt-5 text-sm"><span class="text-primary/60 font-medium">Sanchan Saxena</span>, SVP of Teamwork Collection, Atlassian</figcaption></figure><h2 id="price"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#price">Price</a></h2><p>Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 pricing is identical to Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0. Batch transcription remains $0.10 per hour of audio and streaming $0.20 per hour, with diarization, timestamps, and key terms included.</p><div class="not-prose my-12 lg:-mx-12"><div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2"><div class="bg-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="px-5 py-4"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Batch</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">USD per hour of audio</p></div><div class="px-3 pb-2 pt-1 sm:px-4"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:300px;min-width:0"></div></div></div><div class="bg-card min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="px-5 py-4"><h3 class="text-sm font-medium">Streaming</h3><p class="text-primary mt-1 text-sm">USD per hour of audio</p></div><div class="px-3 pb-2 pt-1 sm:px-4"><div class="recharts-responsive-container" style="width:100%;height:300px;min-width:0"></div></div></div></div></div><p>Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 will soon be the default in the Speech-to-Text API, and Grok Voice Transcribe 1.0 will be deprecated in the coming weeks. To stay on it during the transition, pin <code>grok-voice-transcribe-1.0</code>.</p><div class="not-prose flex flex-col items-center gap-6 text-center mt-20 mb-10 lg:mt-24 lg:mb-12"><h2
